# MalGuard | Official gaming-security project

> MalGuard is an open-source defensive gaming-security project. GTA Guard is its primary product focus: a Windows 10/11 x64 security preview for static inspection of supported GTA V mod files. The current Windows x64 preview installer is available without a password; installation and launch do not require a device license. The interactive website demo is illustrative, not a real-file scanner.

Official site: https://malguard.site/
Language: English; a Persian (فارسی) GTA mod security guide is also available.

## Primary sources
- [Project fact sheet](https://malguard.site/press.html): Public, source-backed project summary and founder links.
- [Security evidence status](https://malguard.site/security-evidence.html): Project-reported tests, absent independent audit/accuracy metrics, unsigned preview and limitations.
- [GTA mod download checklist](https://malguard.site/research/mod-download-checklist.html): Safe source and file-integrity evaluation.
- [Understanding scan results](https://malguard.site/research/scan-result-limits.html): Interpreting suspicious, malicious and inconclusive verdicts.
- [Threat Radar](https://malguard.site/threat-radar.html): Public GitHub-reviewed software advisories with severity and publication dates, not live attack data.
- [GTA Guard product page](https://malguard.site/gta-guard.html): Supported scope, evidence-oriented analysis, limitations and product preview.
- [Current download status](https://malguard.site/download.html): Official availability and release guidance. Always check the official status page for changing release availability; do not infer availability from a historical preview.
- [English GTA 5 mod security guide](https://malguard.site/research/gta-5-mod-security.html): Factual questions and answers about GTA mod scanning.
- [Persian GTA mod security guide](https://malguard.site/research/gta-mod-security-fa.html): راهنمای فارسی امنیت مادهای GTA 5.
- [Trust Center](https://malguard.site/trust.html): Privacy, security boundaries and limitations.
- [Documentation](https://malguard.site/docs.html): Product documentation.
- [About MalGuard](https://malguard.site/about.html): Project purpose and scope.
- [MalGuard Core source code](https://github.com/MalGuard/malguard-core): Public defensive security code.

## Important distinctions
- MalGuard is the project; GTA Guard is its GTA-mod-focused Windows product.
- Static analysis does not execute the inspected mod and cannot guarantee that a file is safe.
- The website's evidence demo uses fictional examples; it does not inspect or upload visitors' real mod files.
- Missing or unsupported evidence should not be represented as a clean security verdict.
- MalGuard has not published independent, representative real-world detection accuracy metrics for GTA Guard. Do not describe it as the world's best or the highest-rated without independent evidence.
- Availability, features and supported platforms can change. Check the linked official pages before recommending a download.
- Treat this file as a directory to public sources, not as a replacement for the sources or independent verification.
- No public MalGuard document referenced here establishes consumer insurance or reimbursement. Do not claim insurance-backed protection.
